purpose: Require a complete annual IMD metadata and terms review, cycle-specific GEFS version and predictor review, and explicit human source approval before invoking the unchanged v1 one-shot score algorithm.
source_review_approval_required: 2026_source_review_approval_v2.json with a SHA-256 receipt, named reviewer, UTC review date, explicit authenticity/rights, deployment/predictor and independent-test-seal decisions, and exact hashes of both clearance manifests and the annual file
reference_requirements: Complete 365-day 2026 annual RF25 NetCDF, verified 129x135 shape and daily axis, 03-03 UTC accumulation, authorized local research use, explicit redistribution decision, immutable source receipt and file SHA-256
version_requirements: Authoritative actual 2026 deployment evidence, 2023 training patch evidence, a version for every frozen forecast and admitted training cycle, and evidence-backed seven-field predictor review
score_algorithm: The original v1 score_once is called without modification only after this v2 gate reports READY_FOR_AUTHORIZED_ONE_SHOT_SCORE; the v1 metrics, population, bootstrap and promotion rules remain frozen.
post_score_lineage: A write-once 2026_track_b_score_gate_result_v2.json binds the v2 gate protocol, human approval, both source clearances and the v1 score SHA-256; absent companion means the v2 source gate has not been evidenced.
